definitions.explanation: The act of delivering ordered goods or products to a customer or client.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧{納品|のうひん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: We are scheduled to deliver tomorrow.

examples.japanese: {納品|のうひん}⟦{日|び}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{納品|のうひん}{書|しょ}→納品書：06594_nouhinsho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦サイン→サイン：03846_sain⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{願|ねが}い→お願い：10299_onegai⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
{納品|のうひん} means delivering ordered goods to a client or customer. The kanji break down as {納|のう} (deliver/supply) + ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (goods). It functions as a noun and ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb, and is primarily used in business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {納品|のうひん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to deliver goods
- {納品|のうひん}⟦{日|び}→日：02249_hi⟧/⟦{納品|のうひん}{期日|きじつ}→納品期日：noentry⟧: delivery date/deadline
- ⟦{納品|のうひん}{書|しょ}→納品書：06594_nouhinsho⟧: delivery slip/invoice
- {納品|のうひん}⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧: delivery destination
- {納品|のうひん}⟦{期限|きげん}→期限：12861_kigen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}う→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧: to make the delivery deadline

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{配達|はいたつ}→配達：00084_haitatsu⟧: general delivery (mail, packages to individuals)
- ⟦{出荷|しゅっか}→出荷：05135_shukka⟧: shipping (sending goods from a warehouse)
- {納品|のうひん}: formal delivery of ordered goods to a business client

{納品|のうひん} implies a business transaction where ordered goods are formally handed over.
